Symbols:
  V: volume of the cultivation medium [L] (computed)
  X_{a}: viable (active) cell dry mass (computed)
  \mu: specific growth rate [h^{-1}] (computed)
  k_{d}: death rate constant of active DM [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  F_{t}: feed rate of the cultivation medium [L h^{-1}] (variable)
  S: sucrose concentration (computed)
  S_{f}: feed medium concentration of sucrose (variable)
  \mu_{S}: specific uptake rate constant for sucrose (parameter)
  K_{S}: sucrose saturation constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{IS}: sucrose inhibition constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  N: nitrate concentration [g L^{-1}] (computed)
  N_{f}: feed medium nitrate concentration (parameter)
  \mu_{N}: nitrate consumption rate [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{N}: nitrate saturation constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{IN}: nitrate inhibition constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  A: ammonium concentration [g L^{-1}] (computed)
  A_{f}: feed medium ammonium concentration (parameter)
  \mu_{A}: ammonium consumption rate [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{A}: ammonium saturation constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{IA}: ammonium inhibition constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  P: phosphate concentration (computed)
  P_{f}: feed medium concentration of phosphate (variable)
  \mu_{P}: Phosphate consumption rate [h^{-1}] (parameter)

  - The model assumes an irreversible progression in which active cells (active DM) are converted into dead cells (dead DM).
